summary: Clarivate Plc announced the expiration and final results of a cash tender offer by its wholly-owned subsidiary Clarivate Science Holdings Corporation for up to $75,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 3.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2028. The offer, launched September 17, 2026, expired 5:00 p.m. New York City time on September 23, 2026, with withdrawal rights lapsing at expiration. Global Bondholder Services Corporation served as tender and information agent. This is a liability-management repurchase of secured debt, not an equity event; watch acceptance proration, final participation versus the maximum amount, and any signal about balance-sheet deleveraging or refinancing plans ahead of the 2028 maturity.
